# 2026-08-05 · Settlement currency on the order

Change ID: `settlement-currency`
Created: `2026-08-05T15:03:41+00:00`
Risk: R2
Status: In progress

## Problem and intended outcome

Two partners onboarding this quarter settle in currencies other than USD.
Today the currency is implied by the partner and hard-coded at the reporting
layer, which is already wrong for one existing partner and is being worked
around by hand each month.

The intended outcome is that the settlement currency is stored on the order
itself and read from the row at reporting time, rather than derived from a
per-partner lookup.

## Success and non-goals

Success is that reporting reads the currency straight from the order row for
every partner, with no hand correction, and that the adapter payload carries
the currency it actually settles in.

Not in scope: a per-partner currency table, and re-deriving the currency for
historic orders beyond backfilling them to USD.

## Existing responsibilities searched

`src/db/schema.py` owns the stored order representation, so the new
`settlement_currency` column belongs there. `src/api/partner_adapter.py`
already owns the settlement payload shape (and, per
`partner-settlement-rounding`, the amount-unit conversion), so it also owns
adding currency to that payload. The reporting read path does not exist in
`src/` yet; it is currently the hard-coded value this change removes.

## System and data flow

Order row (`amount_cents`, `settlement_currency`) -> `to_partner_payload` ->
partner settlement API. Separately: order row -> reporting read path,
replacing the hard-coded per-partner currency lookup once that path reads the
column.

## Decisions and trade-offs

Store currency on the order rather than in a per-partner table. Currency is a
property of the agreement in force when the order was placed, not of the
partner today; a table loses that once an agreement changes. See
`docs/proposals/settlement-currency.md` for the full discussion.

## Failure, security, and recovery

A missing or wrong currency mis-reports settlement amounts, the same risk
class as `partner-settlement-rounding`. The new column has a default of
`'USD'`, so the schema change is additive and non-breaking; rollback is
dropping the column and reverting the adapter/reporting changes. Backfilling
historic rows to USD is safe because every order placed so far was USD.

## Verification evidence

None yet. The schema column is added but uncommitted; the adapter and
reporting changes have not started, and no tests cover currency yet.

## Known limits and learning gaps

Step 2 (backfill mechanism for existing rows) is not designed yet. Step 3
(adapter payload) will land in the same file that
`partner-settlement-rounding` modified for unit conversion, so that change
should be checked for conflicts before this one lands there.

## References

- Proposal: `docs/proposals/settlement-currency.md`
- Plan: `plans/settlement-currency.md`
